sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 5x5x5 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 4. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (4-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,4-z,y).
Which pair occupies the same cell in the FRONT projection because only their y-coordinates differ?
A. B & D
B. A & B
C. A & C
D. A & D
E. A & E
F. B & C
sample.analysis: Front projection keeps (x,z) and collapses y. A is at (3, 2, 2); B is at (3, 4, 2). Their (x,z) values match, so the answer is B.
